svg.text: Lower body strength + endurance — Session C
Focus block · 10 targets · hip, knee, ankle, spine at loading stage 1 · shoulder 2 · ~26.5 min · 12 working sets
Muscle group
Hamstrings
Hips
Shin, ankle & popliteus
Before: lower mobility routine, pre half · then light warm-up sets before each strength lift
Outside the exercise time (R19) · strength load: ≈60% in weeks 1–2, ≈80% in weeks 3–4, 100% from week 5 (R22)
100% = the load that leaves 3 in reserve after 3 reps: reach it from below from week 5, no maximum test (R16)
Guide: ≈60% is a load you could lift 20+ times, ≈80% about 12–15 times · week 1 = your first session
Endurance: a band or position you could work 15–18 times — 12–15 reps with 3 in reserve (Stage 0 §2.2)
A — Straight sets: Hamstrings (strength · ~8.5 min · 2 sets · 2–4 min rest after each)
Smith Romanian deadlift
Hamstrings (L) · glutes and erectors assist
Bar close along the thighs · spine neutral · soft knees and elbows
Safeties near mid-shin, at ~70–80% of your range: the bar stops there
3 RIR · every week
Smith · safeties
B — Straight sets: Adductors (strength · ~8.5 min · 2 sets · 2–4 min rest after each)
Hip adduction machine
Adductors (M) · seated · pads on the thighs above the knees
Start with the legs open to ~70–80% of your range, not end range
3 RIR · every week
Hip machine
C — Superset 1: Evertors + Popliteus (endurance · ~5 min · 2 rounds · ≤30 s rest)
Band ankle eversion, both feet
Evertors (S) · seated · one band round both forefeet
Turn both soles out to ~70–80% of your range · both feet together
3 RIR · every week
Band
↕ then immediately
Popliteus banded internal rotation, both legs
Popliteus (S) · sit, knees soft-bent 20–40° over the foam roller
A long band round each forefoot, anchored low on that side
Turn both shins in together, thighs still · ~70–80% of your range
3 RIR · every week
2 long bands · frame · roller
D — Superset 2: Tibialis + Hip flexors (endurance · ~4.5 min · 2 rounds · ≤30 s rest)
Tibialis raise (back against the wall)
Tibialis (M) · lift the toes to ~70–80% of your range · both legs together
Harder: stand with the feet further from the wall
3 RIR · every week
Wall
↕ then immediately
Supine bent-knee leg lift to tabletop, both legs
Hip flexors (M) · abs assist · knees bent ~90°, lift both feet to tabletop
Low back flat: stop the lowering where it starts to arch
Harder: knees a little straighter, only while the low back stays flat
3 RIR · every week
Floor
After: lower mobility routine, post half
Next day, train only if that morning's step gate passes for every joint both sessions load (R20)
Every rep, every set — hypermobility rules
Lower every rep over 2–3 s; keep a soft bend at every joint, no lockout (R25 · R2)
Work to ~70–80% of your range, never end range; the safeties end squat and hinge depth (R1 · R3 · R11)
Skip the session if joints feel loose; end a set the moment a joint feels unstable (R9)
Strength: 3 reps with 3 in reserve, every week — from week 5 a load you could lift 6 times (R17 · R22)
Strength rest: 2–4 min after each set or pair, as the next set needs (Stage 0 §2.2)
Endurance: 12–15 reps with 3 in reserve, every week; rest ≤30 s after each pair (R17)
Both legs together on every exercise: one-leg work waits for loading stage 3 (R12)
Progress strength from week 5: 3 reps leave over 3 in reserve, twice running → smallest load step (R42)
Progress endurance: 15 reps twice running → a harder band or position, reps back to 12 (R42)
Log the step gate after each session; a fail repeats last week's dose for that joint (§2.6 · R43)
Session timeline
Mobility pre half → warm-up sets → A → B → C → D → mobility post half
Exercise time ≈26.5 min (R40: 4 s a rep, top of every range, 4 min or 30 s rest by goal) · 12 working sets
Working sets — here · week (direct + half-sets from compounds)
Strength · 4 a target (R34)
Quads 0 · week 4
Hamstrings 2 · week 4
Calves 0 · week 4
Hip abductors 0 · week 4
Adductors 2 · week 4
Glutes 0 · week 0 + 4.0 from the squat and RDL (R36)
Endurance · 4 a target (R34)
Evertors 2 · week 4
Popliteus 2 · week 4
Tibialis 2 · week 4
Hip flexors 2 · week 4
Alternatives — if a station is taken (R41) · ⚠ R30: cannot reach a strength load
